name: consec_air_carry_pays_phi_of_the_length_then_refunds_on_landing
description: The car flies level at 1500 uu/s (z 900) into the floating ball and PUSHES it: in the engine a push registers a touch on every step of the contact (frames 8 to 25, 18 steps), so this is an 18-touch chain. Hand calc with gamma 0.9969: frame 8 (streak 1) 0; frame 9 pays gamma*Phi(2) = 0.9969*0.393469 = 0.39225 (+15.7 at weight 40); frame 10 pays gamma*Phi(3) - Phi(2) = 0.23669, cumulative 0.62894; the chain saturates (Phi(18) = 0.9998, cumulative about 0.97 = +38.6 weighted). While the chain is held it bleeds (gamma-1)*Phi per step. The car lands on frame 29 and the whole chain is refunded; over the whole run the reward nets only the bleed, -0.0572 (-2.3 weighted). The ball starts with a 1 uu/s upward velocity on purpose (a ball set with exactly zero velocity in the air floats: see tools/reward_lab/README.md). Verified independently: a separate script that recomputes the streak from the exported on-ground and touched flags reproduces every step's reward to 1e-7.

expect.intent: the car keeps touching the ball from frame 8 to 25
the first air touch (frame 8) and everything before it pays nothing
the second chained touch pays gamma * Phi(2) = 0.39225
the third adds gamma * Phi(3) - Phi(2): cumulative 0.62894
the chain saturates near 0.96-0.97 (about +38.6 weighted, under the 40 cap)
landing refunds the whole chain: the run nets only the holding bleed, -0.0572
